sloka: तं विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दृष्ट्वा निपतितं भुवि ।सञ्जातरोषौ दुर्धर्षावुत्पेततुररिन्दमौ ।। ५.४६.२७।।।।
transliteration: taṁ virūpākṣayūpākṣau dṛṣṭvā nipatitaṁ bhuvi ।sañjātaroṣau durdharṣāvutpetaturarindamau ।। 5.46.27।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the body of Durdhara fallen on the ground, enraged Virupaksha and Yupaksha, the unassailable crushers of enemies leaped towards him.
